description: Observed liquidation price levels for BTC, ETH, SOL or HYPE: where open positions of the largest wallets would liquidate, bucketed by price, with realized liquidations on the same axis and the share of open interest observed. Not a forecast. CONCISE (default) returns the densest levels and coverage in a few hundred tokens; DETAILED returns the full grid. Result carries provenance.
name: tape_liquidation_heatmap
title: Hyperliquid Liquidation Heatmap
